evals.prompt: 从零规划一个研发团队的任务看板工具，梳理产品 UX 流程。
evals.expected_output: End-to-end macro product UX lifecycle documentation covering requirements, user scenarios, IA, wireframes, and handoff.
expectations: Defines product goals and measurable business/usability success criteria (Stage 1)
Maps full user journey including Happy Path, branch decisions, and edge paths (Stage 2)
Outlines low-fidelity wireframe layout before visual styling (Stage 2)
Includes design system token/component alignment and developer handoff package structure (Stage 3 & 4)

evals.prompt: Design the end-to-end UX workflow and wireframe architecture for a mobile habit-tracking application.
evals.expected_output: Four-stage product design workflow optimizing mobile habit creation, streak visualization, and responsive touch layout.
expectations: Conducts user context analysis (one-handed mobile usage, habit trigger points)
Produces step-by-step user flow from onboarding to core daily habit check-in
Enforces wireframe verification before high-fidelity visual design
Specifies mobile responsive layout and touch target conventions
Includes design rationale and decision documentation for developer handoff
